# After Effects / Premiere motion reel

Drop your exported COURTSIDE motion reel here as:

```
courtside-reel.mp4
```

Recommended:
- 1920 × 1080
- H.264 / AAC
- 10–20 seconds
- Under ~8MB for web

The Motion section auto-detects this file and swaps the placeholder for a video player. No code changes required.

Suggested contents:
1. COURTSIDE intro (2–3s)
2. Series sting
3. Lower third + player ID
4. Statistic reveal
5. Score / transition wipe
6. End card — EVERY POSSESSION HAS A STORY.
